metadata.scope: Post-primary training-only SAT reuse diagnostic; no held-out instances or heuristic feedback
metadata.method_order: Cyclic rotations across the three repetitions, balanced within each instance
metadata.query_order: All ascending odd proper masks; variable 1 on left
metadata.timing_contract: End-to-end includes encoding, solver setup, assumptions, solving, counter collection, query record assembly and solver deletion; excludes imports, input parsing, hashing, JSON I/O and independent evaluation. Full subprocess time is recorded separately.
metadata.counter_contract: Raw solver totals include initialization propagation; per-query deltas subtract pre-solve counters. No learned-clause count is measured or inferred.
metadata.encoding_contract: Both controlled methods use the byte-identical Phase4 selector encoding over singleton blocks, not the Phase5B equality-enabled shrinking encoding. The fresh Phase3 method has its own cut-specific CNF.
metadata.failures_contract: Timeout/error/incorrect runs remain explicit. No geometric-mean comparison is emitted unless all 180 runs and every expected query succeed.
